items.title: Assistant Industrial Door Engineer
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Assistant Industrial Door Engineer
Full Time
Milton Keynes
Competitive salary with regular overtime, depot performance bonus after one year of service, private healthcare, company uniform and excellent pension.
Overview
This is an opportunity to join one of the first specialist Industrial Door Companies with over 50 years of trading history. They service, repair and install a wide range of equipment including industrial doors, personnel doors, gates, grilles and barriers.
The Role
Normal working hours are Monday to Friday between 8:00am to 5:00pm, with reasonable overtime as required, usually within 40 miles of Milton Keynes.
The objective of this role is to work alongside one of their existing Senior Engineers to learn the industry and gain knowledge, with the possibility of future progression within the company.
For people with the right aptitude and attitude, there are great long term career prospects and development programme.
The Person:
Good attitude to work and the willingness / interest to learn
Have good attendance and time keeping
While not essential, an interest in mechanics, engineering and electrics would be beneficial
They Offer:
Full training and development with a good potential career path
Competitive salary – dependent on experience, knowledge and qualifications
Overtime
Contributory pension scheme
31 days holiday including bank holidays
Performance related payment for attendance and depot profitability, after initial probation period
PPE and company uniform provided
A good work life balance
Healthcare scheme
Job Types: Full-Time, Permanent
Salary: £26,436.80 / OTE: £28,000 – £32,000
Additional Pay:
Performance bonus
Overtime
Out of hours callout payments

items.text:
Junior Electrical Maintenance Engineer £40,000 - £50,000 + Multi-skilled Training + Bonus + Overtime + Benefits Milton Keynes (Commutable from: Luton, Bedford, Northampton, Hitchin, Banbury, Brackley, Buckingham, Towcester, Bletchley)
Do you have any Electrical qualifications or experience ooking to work in a purpose built and modern facility with continued training and highly competitive benefits?
On offer is a great opportunity to technically progress your career whilst working within a friendly, stable and secure team of Engineers.
This multi-million pound Manufacturer trade as experts within the Packaging sector. As a result they have an additional position available in the Maintenance team.
Within this position you will be expected to fault find, repair and maintain a range of bespoke electro-mechanical production equipment at their large and modern facility. The shift pattern is a Panama with days and nights rotation.
This role would suit an Electrical Engineer / Electrical looking to work on specialist controls systems, huge on target earnings and be in stable employment.

Fault-find, repair and maintain a range of Electro-Mechanical equipment.
Panama Shift pattern (2 on 2 off, 3 on, 3 off)
Days and Nights rotation.
PPM and breakdowns in a Production facility.

Maintenance experience.
Electrically qualified
Manufacturing / FMCG environment preferred.

In this role you will be responsible for the servicing, repairing, and installing loading bays, dock levels, and scissor lifts. You will be working within a 3-hour patch paid door to door in a provided van.

Week 1: 6:00am - 2:00pm
Week 2: 12:00pm - 8:00pm
Monday to Friday

You will be working across various departments within the manufacturing facility, including:
Assembly
Welding
Rolling
Sorting
Cleaning
General production duties as required
This is a varied, hands-on role, so flexibility and a willingness to work across different departments is essential.
Requirements
You must live in Milton Keynes or be able to reliably commute.
Previous experience in a manufacturing or production environment is essential.
A good work ethic, attention to detail, and the ability to work as part of a team.

items.text:
Production Operative
Pay rate: £16.87 per hour-basic hour
£25.31 per hour-overtime rate
Location: Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire
Shift Times:
6:00 AM – 6:00 PM
6:00 PM – 6:00 AM
Shift Pattern: 4 on / 4 off (2 days, 2 nights)
Must be able to work both days and nights.
Breaks: Two 30-minute paid breaks per shift
Due to site requirements, smoking is not allowed on site.
About the Role
We are recruiting Production Operatives to join a fast-paced manufacturing company in Milton Keynes. You’ll work in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment, supporting production for well-known brands. This role is ideal for reliable, detail-focused individuals who enjoy hands-on work and being part of a strong production team.
Responsibilities as a Production Operative
Set up, operate, and monitor lines, conveyors to ensure the production runs smoothly
Accurately record quality and production data, reporting any non-conformances
Pack, seal, label, and prepare finished products for dispatch
Maintain high standards of hygiene and cleanliness
Clean equipment and work areas to prevent contamination
Carry out basic machine maintenance and report or troubleshoot minor faults
Follow all health & safety, food safety, and site procedures at all times
Work as part of a team to ensure the site is audit-ready
Skills & Experience Required as a Production Operative
Previous experience in production and manufacturing desirable
Strong attention to detail and quality standards
Ability to work with small components and follow detailed instructions
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment
Reliable, punctual, and a strong team player
Good communication and problem-solving skills
Willingness to work days and nights on a rotating shift pattern
What We Offer
Competitive pay with enhanced overtime rates
Paid breaks
Ongoing work with temp-to-perm opportunities
Structured training and development
Clean, organised, and safety-focused working environment
Long-term career opportunities within a prestigious company

items.text: We are looking for Production Operatives who can lead the way in delivering our customers tasty high quality Brioche products. We want to find candidates with the desire to grow and progress within the company with the support of ongoing professional training and development. Location: Milton Keynes Contract Type: Full Time/Permanent Hours: All our Production Operative roles are based on working a continental shift pattern of 4 on 4 off, rotating between both day and night shifts with working hours being 06:00 to 18:00 (days) / 18:00 to 06:00 (nights). Small variations may occur depending on the production line to which you are assigned. Starting Salary: We offer a competitive starting salary of £30,551 per annum (£14.33 per hour), incl. of night shift allowance. Rates increasing as training progresses and assessments are complete. Note: We are currently not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Benefits (subject to length of service): • Company Pension Plan (with 7% company investment) • Westfield Health Plan (reclaim some basic healthcare costs) • Company Sick Pay and Income Protection Plan • Life Assurance. About the Role: • Monitor, control and manage baking machines and equipment. • Monitor the smooth running of the work area processes. • Perform and record regular quality checks to deadline. • Participate in the cleaning of the production machines and equipment. • Work to high standards of health & safety and Food safety measures. About You: • Have a flexible ‘can do’ approach to the work you do • Enjoy working and contributing to a team • Have a keen eye for detail • A willingness to learn and develop • Some experience working in a busy food production position would be an advantage, but full training will be given for the right person. About Brioche Pasquier: This is your opportunity to work for one of the largest food manufactures in Europe, Brioche Pasquier. We have been present in the UK for over 2 decades and sell a range of French bakery products to major UK food retailers, wholesale and food service markets. The company is still family run and has a culture reflective of the closeness and respect this brings with a history reaching back to 1936. We are still a growing international company with a strong manufacturing presence in Europe, South Korea and USA and products presence in over 50 other countries. We are at our 240,000 sq. ft. technologically advanced production facility to service the UK market in order to continue the strong growth of the company. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a category-leading brand and an exciting stage in the history of the business. REF- 230 543

items.text:
Contract Type: Permanent - Fulltime
Shift Pattern/ Time: Friday -Tuesday & Wednesday -Sunday, 05:00-13:30
Rate: £14.84 p/h
Location: Greencore Northampton, Clayfield Close, NN3 6QN
(Please note this is a FULL-TIME role only)
Why Greencore?
Following the combination with Bakkavor in January 2026, we're one of the UK's leading creators of convenience food, driven by a simple purpose: to make every day taste better. As a vibrant and fast-moving business, we're proud to employ over 28,000 talented colleagues across 36 manufacturing sites and 21 distribution depots in the UK and the US. Together, we bring delicious food to life. Our products cover every meal occasion from breakfast through to dinner and dessert, with lunch and snacking in between. In FY25, our shared passion helped us achieve combined revenues of approximately £4bn. Our extensive direct to store (DTS) network, with 17 depots across the UK, allows us to deliver fresh and frozen food both our own and from trusted partners to thousands of stores every day, ensuring consumers enjoy the very best, whenever and wherever they shop.
Here at Northampton , we operate one of the most impressive facilities in Europe, based across a campus of 5 manufacturing units, and we have a team of around 2,000 colleagues making high quality premium products every day . We are the sole supplier of sandwiches, wraps, rolls and sushi for Marks & Spencer.
What you'll be doing
Daily machinery start-up and continuous oversight
Reporting machinery faults as necessary
Ensuring correct label usage to maintain high standards
Regular completion of compliance checks, including date and code verification
Adherence to compliance controls, risk assessments, and Safe Systems of Work (SSOW)
Ensuring a safe working environment for colleagues and oneself
Performing relevant quality checks and promptly addressing quality or food safety issues
Collaboration within a close-knit production team
What we're looking for
Good numeracy and English Language skills both verbal and written
Can demonstrate working in a safe manner and do good H&S practices
Accurate and pays attention to detail Ability to work well under pressure.
Knowledge of and or experience of working in a FMCG/Warehouse would be advantageous, though full training is provided.
At Greencore we put our people at the core. We celebrate their differences and help everyone to be themselves at work. Together we make every day taste better. If this sounds like you, join us and grow with Greencore, and be a part of driving our future success.
What you'll get in return
Competitive salary and job-related benefits
Holidays
Competitive matched pension contributions
Life insurance up to 4x salary
Company share save scheme
Greencore Qualifications
Exclusive Greencore employee discount platform
Access to a full Wellbeing Centre platform
Throughout your time at Greencore, you will be supported with on the job training and development opportunities to further your career.
Greencore and its recruitment partners never charge candidates any fees at any stage of the hiring process. Any request for payment relating to a job opportunity should be considered fraudulent.

items.text:
Warehouse Operative - Rework & Picking
Location: Milton Keynes Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 4:40pm Pay: £12.71 per hour Contract: Temporary, with the opportunity to become permanent for the right person
Newstaff MK are currently recruiting for a Warehouse Operative to join our client's team in Milton Keynes.
We are looking for someone who is reliable, hardworking and happy working both independently and as part of a team. The role involves picking, packing and rework , including some heavy lifting.
The Role
Your duties will include:
Picking and packing orders for overseas customers
Reading and accurately following information on pick notes
Using a PC to input and update information
Picking customer orders for rework
Re-labelling items accurately
Repacking products ready for dispatch
Checking labels and product information carefully
Carrying out general warehouse duties
Some heavy lifting will be involved
About You
The successful candidate will:
Have excellent attention to detail, particularly when re-labelling items
Be comfortable using a PC and entering information accurately
Be able to follow written instructions and pick notes
Be reliable and punctual
Have a good work ethic and a positive attitude
Be happy working on your own as well as part of a team
Be comfortable carrying out repetitive tasks and rework duties
Have your own safety boots and high-visibility vest
Be available to work Monday to Friday, with no weekend work
Applicants must be based in the Milton Keynes area.
This is initially a temporary position with the opportunity to become permanent for the right person .
How to Apply
We only accept up-to-date CVs accompanied by a covering letter .
Please email your CV and covering letter to:
Alternatively, you can call the Newstaff MK team on:
Please note: Newstaff MK is a recruitment agency. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately not always able to respond to every applicant individually.
If you have not heard from a member of our team within 72 hours , please assume that, at this stage, your application has been unsuccessful for this role.
If you are reliable, well-presented, customer-focused and genuinely want to work , we would like to hear from you.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
FINANCIAL OPERATIONS ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICERS
Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
Reference number: 478200
Salary: Total Package: £29,500 (East Kilbride) + location allowance of £1,750 (Milton Keynes)
Contract: Full time, permanent
Location: East Kilbride or Milton Keynes
Hours: Full time. You’ll be required to work in line with our policies on hybrid working (minimum 60% in the office)
We lead the UK’s diplomatic, development and consular work around the world. We employ around 17,000 staff in our global network of 281 offices worldwide. Our UK-based staff work in King Charles Street in London, Abercrombie House in East Kilbride and Hanslope Park in Milton Keynes.
Your role with us
Our Finance Operations Department is at the heart of the FCDO, working to deliver public-facing services, projects, programmes and statutory commitments while protecting value for money, ensuring transparency and managing risks. We’re currently looking to recruit eighteen enthusiastic Financial Operations Administrative Officers to work on transaction processing, projects, budgets, customer service functions and communications.
Join our friendly team in either East Kilbride or Milton Keynes and you’ll have a wide range of day-to-day responsibilities, including:
Checking invoices to ensure their accuracy, processing, reconciling and investigating payments, issuing invoices, calculating and paying pension benefits and dealing with FCDO credit card issues
Resolving queries and providing professional guidance to our customers
Maintaining Excel spreadsheets, databases, records and desk notes
Creating and maintaining electronic filing systems and distribution lists
Dealing with telephone, email and postal enquiries
Organising and taking notes at meetings and events
Maintaining stationery supplies
Assisting with project management tasks, including monitoring progress, ensuring tasks are on schedule, anticipating and managing risks, and maintaining records
Monitoring budgets, raising purchase orders, using spreadsheets to manipulate data, helping with budget forecasting and working on commercial and procurement policies
Acting in various corporate roles such as first aider, for which training will be provided
Who we’re looking for
To be successful in this busy role you’ll be a collaborative team worker with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and a strong commitment to delivering a service of the highest quality. Highly organised and with excellent literacy, numeracy and IT skills, you should be a confident user of IT packages including the Microsoft Office suite of software and have experience of mailbox management.
With well developed planning and analytical skills, and the ability to work to tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment, you’ll also be capable of making effective decisions, identifying problems and proposing solutions.
Please be aware that you must be a British Citizen at the time of application and be required to attain Developed Vetting (DV) security clearance.
We value diversity and inclusion and actively encourage and welcome applications from all communities. Everyone here gets the support to develop their skills and capabilities as well as benefits that help to make the most of life in and out of work, including a Civil Service pension.
Use your talent and experience to shape our nation’s future, and deliver tangible improvements to millions of lives, including your own.
Closing date: Apply before 11:55 pm on Monday 12th October 2026.

items.text: Applications Technician Are you a consultative Applications Technician, Technical Support Specialist, Sales Support? Are you seeking to develop your career in a professional, high-quality precision, branded engineering environment? We are interested in receiving applications from a wide variety of smart, ambitious professionals, from junior level to fully-fledged. This job offers plenty of variety, and we will provide you with full consultative sales support and technical product training. BASIC SALARY: £27,000 - £33,000 BENEFITS: ·25 Days Annual Leave (plus Bank Holidays) ·Company Pension - matched to 5% ·Private Healthcare (for Employee and Family) ·Life Assurance Cover ·Extensive Training LOCATION: Letchworth Garden City - this is an office based role COMMUTABLE LOCATIONS: Stevenage, Hitchin, Luton, Royston, Biggleswade, Shefford, Buntingford, Baldock, Radwell. JOB DESCRIPTION: Applications Technician, Technical Support Specialist, Applications Specialist, Sales Support As our Application Technician, you will play a pivotal role in showcasing our cutting-edge equipment and supporting the sales process. Your responsibilities will encompass conducting equipment demonstrations, providing technical support to both customers and the sales team, and maintaining our demonstration suite. Your proactive approach will be crucial in directly influencing our sales success and customer satisfaction. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Applications Technician, Technical Support Specialist, Applications Specialist, Sales Support Your duties and responsibilities will be varied, including: ·Planning, setting up and delivering machine and software demonstrations, tailored to highlight the features and benefits of our equipment (in person and online). ·Collaborate with Sales Account Managers to demonstrate our range of equipment and applications to new and existing customers, with the goal of driving machine sales. ·Working with Customer Relationship Executives to showcase our products and software, aiming to sell upgrades and additional tooling. ·Handling administration and post demonstration tasks, including documenting details of the demo, tidying the demo suite and returning / disposing of materials. ·Conducting test demos for new and existing customers. ·Maintaining the demonstration suite to ensure it is always clean, smart, presentable, and fully operational, ensuring all machines and tooling are in perfect working condition. ·Keep software suites updated, ensuring optimal functionality. ·Provide technical assistance to customers over the phone, offering guidance on selection, material setting and application queries. ·Deliver technical advice, training sessions and assistance to Sales Account Managers, Marketing Manager and Customer Relationship Executives to enhance the sales process. ·Represent us at trade shows, exhibitions, and open days, setting up and demonstrating our equipment. PERSON SPECIFICATION: Applications Technician, Technical Support Specialist, Applications Specialist, Sales Support You will have the following traits and qualities: ·Proactive and enthusiastic about demonstrating and selling equipment. ·Strong organisational skills with a keen eye for detail. ·Excellent technical knowledge and the ability to troubleshoot and advise on machine settings. ·Effective presentation skills for engaging with customers and supporting sales. ·Flexibility to handle a variety of tasks and responsibilities as needed. OUR COMPANY: We are a multiple-award winning manufacturer of prestigious brands in technical / industrial equipment and are recognised worldwide as "State of the Art" innovators of high-value capital solutions which are used in a wide range of industries. With a first-class reputation, we pride ourselves in excellent customer care and as part of our organic growth programme, we are seeking to employ ambitious individuals with the aspiration to become the very best that they can be. We constantly strive to develop our staff to take on additional responsibilities and grow professionally. It is highly likely you will have worked in any of the following roles and/or markets, and worked with the following products and/or services: Applications Technician, Technical Support Specialist, or Applications Specialist, Applications Engineer, Sales Support. INTERESTED? Please click apply. You will receive an acknowledgement of your application. Wallace Hind Selection, alongside our client embrace diversity, champion equality, and foster inclusion to create a work environment where everyone belongs and thrives. Please Note: Wallace Hind Selection have been chosen as the retained recruitment partner of our client and therefore any direct applications to our client from candidates or agencies will be forwarded on to us direct. REF: JK Wallace HInd Selection

Location: Milton Keynes, MK7 8
PROMAN is recruiting Production & Administration Operatives for one of the UK's leading providers of electronic and paper document distribution services.
This is an opportunity to join an organisation that plays a vital role in supporting the NHS, government departments, and major commercial businesses across the UK. The work you do will help ensure critical information reaches the people who need it, making a real difference every day.
If you're looking for a stable role with a reputable employer, a supportive team environment, and the chance to develop your skills within a fast-paced production setting, we'd love to hear from you.
What's on offer?
£13.45 per hour
40 hours per week
Monday to Friday
13:00 - 22:00 shift pattern
Work for a market-leading organisation
Be part of a team delivering essential services nationwide
Ongoing training and development opportunities
The Role
As a Production & Administration Operative, you'll be responsible for producing and dispatching business-critical documents accurately, securely, and efficiently.
Your duties will include:
Operating production machinery safely and effectively
Printing, inserting, and dispatching confidential customer documents
Performing quality checks to ensure the highest standards are maintained
Identifying and reporting equipment issues or inefficiencies
Carrying out basic machine maintenance and housekeeping tasks
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives within the department
Planning and organising daily activities to meet production targets
Escalating any concerns promptly to minimise disruption
What We're Looking For
We're looking for motivated individuals who take pride in their work and enjoy being part of a successful team.
You will:
Have excellent attention to detail and accuracy
Be reliable with a strong attendance record
Be able to work independently as well as collaboratively
Understand the importance of confidentiality and data security
Be proactive, organised, and eager to learn
Have a positive, can-do attitude and strong work ethic
Be confident raising concerns and suggesting improvements when required
Essential Experience
Previous experience in a fast-paced production or operational environment
Experience working towards targets and deadlines
Good verbal communication, literacy, and numeracy skills
Ability to follow procedures and maintain high levels of accuracy
Strong problem-solving skills and confidence to escalate issues when necessary
Apply Today
If you're looking for a rewarding role where your work genuinely matters and you can be part of a team supporting essential services across the UK, apply now and start your next career move with PROMAN.
Our clients and their customers come from diverse backgrounds and so do we. We hire our people from various walks of life, each of whom make our company stronger with their talent, uniqueness, and expertise. This is what makes our company special; if you want to help us grow and take this ethos to our clients, then we cannot wait to collaborate with you! The UK has now left the European Union. items.text:
Are you a Trainee Engineer or Technical Machine Operator looking to gain hands-on engineering experience in a fast-paced FMCG factory environment. This Junior Maintenance Engineer role offers structured training, a supportive working culture, and a shift pattern that helps you balance life outside of work. If you enjoy problem-solving, want to build practical skills, and are motivated to progress, this Junior Maintenance Engineer opportunity could be your next smart step.
Shift Pattern- 4 on 4 off Days & Nights
What You Will Do:
- Help deliver scheduled preventative maintenance to keep production running smoothly and safely.
- Respond quickly to breakdowns in designated areas, identifying likely causes and suggesting improvements to reduce repeat issues.
- Communicate effectively with the Engineering Shift Manager or Principal Engineer and work with operations to minimise disruption.
- Follow engineering standards and maintain strong hygiene practices in a high-compliance manufacturing setting.
- Support timely reporting of Health and Safety, Animal Welfare, and Environmental issues as required.
- Raise stock and non-stock request forms to support maintenance activities and continuous improvement.
What You Will Bring:
- Machine minder or technical operator experience, or practical exposure to factory environments.
- A strong desire to develop into engineering, with a clear motivation to learn and take on new responsibilities as a Junior Maintenance Engineer.
- Numerical and reasoning ability suitable for entry-level technical apprenticeship requirements, including Functional Skills Level 2 in Literacy and Numeracy and a pass in the Technical Abilities Test.
- Confidence working in an environment where safe working practices and attention to detail matter every shift.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team, with good communication skills and a positive attitude.
This Junior Maintenance Engineer role sits within a major food production supply chain, supporting reliable manufacturing for short shelf-life products where hygiene standards are critical. By keeping machinery in excellent condition, contributing to safe maintenance practices, and supporting continuous improvement, you directly help production teams meet performance expectations while upholding high standards across the site.
Location:
The Junior Maintenance Engineer role is based in Brackley.
Interested?:
Think this sounds like the right next move for a Junior Maintenance Engineer? Apply today and take the first step towards a secure career with training, progression, and real day-to-day engineering impact.
Your CV will be forwarded to Jonathan Lee Recruitment, a leading engineering and manufacturing recruitment consultancy established in 1978. The services advertised by Jonathan Lee Recruitment are those of an Employment Agency. In order for your CV to be processed effectively, please ensure your name, email address, phone number and location (post code OR town OR county, as a minimum) are included.

items.text:
Hue Recruitment is currently recruiting for Warehouse / Production Operators to join an established packaging manufacturing business in Olney.
This is a hands-on position working within a busy production and warehouse environment , supporting the manufacturing process from preparing raw materials through to packing and preparing finished products for dispatch.
The role would suit someone who is reliable, physically capable and looking for a long-term opportunity with the potential to become permanent.
The Role
Your responsibilities will include:
Stripping and preparing packaging materials for production
Feeding materials into production machinery
Operating and assisting with packaging machinery
Removing finished products from machinery
Packing, stacking and preparing finished products for dispatch
Moving raw materials and finished stock around the factory
Carrying out basic quality checks on finished products
Manual handling and general warehouse duties
Supporting the production team to maintain an efficient workflow
Keeping production and warehouse areas clean, organised and safe
Following production instructions and Health & Safety procedures
Requirements
Previous experience in a warehouse, factory, manufacturing, packaging or production environment would be advantageous
Comfortable carrying out manual handling and physically active duties
Reliable, punctual and hardworking
Able to follow instructions and work safely around machinery
Good attention to detail, particularly when carrying out quality checks
Able to work effectively as part of a team
Positive attitude and willingness to learn

Monday to Friday, 8:00am–4:30pm
Day shifts
No weekend working
Full-time, temporary-to-permanent opportunity
Modern working premises
On-site parking
Christmas closure
Holiday entitlement
Pension
Apply Now

Big things are happening at Topps Group, home to premier UK tile brands including CTD, Topps Tiles, Pro Tiler Tools, Parkside and Fired Earth. We are committed to delivering exceptional service to our clients.

Provide operational support by undertaking picking, packing, and other warehouse duties as required to meet customer and business demands.

Key Skills & Experience:

Strong knowledge of WMS, ERP, or inventory management systems.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and as part of a small team.
Good problem-solving and communication skills.
Flexibility to support warehouse picking and operational activities when required.

items.text:
Now recruiting for an Orders Administrator to join an industry leading provider in Dunstable who are renowned for supplying products and services that you'd see on TV and at some of the largest events in the UK.
In this role you'd be 100% focussed on supporting the team with invoices, PO's and quotation support - So you'd be spending a lot of time on the system working through all documentation linked to orders and projects but equally you'd need to be speaking to project managers, clients, engineers etc. where required.
This is going to be an ideal role for someone with previous office experience, ideally, we're looking for someone with good communication and people skills, and we need this person to come with some form of relevant orders processing or invoicing experience.
You'd be joining a well-established company and a high-functioning team of very kind, supportive and fun people with a real work hard, play hard attitude.
This is a temporary position to start, you'd be earning a salary of £28k which would be weekly pay at an hourly rate of £14.56 per hour (+ holiday pay accrual) - With a view to this going temp to perm for the right person down the line.
Hybrid working is on offer here as standard and you'd be doing so from week 2, working 3 days in the offices in Dunstable and 2 days from home weekly (Usually Mon-Weds in the offices and Thurs/Fri WFH).
The team operate Monday to Friday, 8.30am to 5pm with an hour's lunch break.
What to expect day-to-day:
Generating and processing up to approximately 200 invoices, POs and other order documents per month.
Running weekly reports to help your team track project timeframes and targets.
Quote building - Lots of admin/data input to create quotes whilst speaking to customers
Candidate Skills:
Some form of previous office experience is essential, particularly dealing with invoicing, processing orders, raising POs or similar.
Communication skills are very important in this role, working alongside internal contacts and communication with project managers, engineers and customers in the field.
Must be comfortable with working from home a few times a week and have a good wifi connection and dedicated work space.
The ability to work with your own initiative.
Multitasking, juggling and managing your own workload.
A positive and can-do outlook and approach.
A team player.

Are you an experienced Warehouse Operative looking for a role where quality, pride and teamwork genuinely matter? Do you want to be part of something brand new right from day one? Would you enjoy having the opportunity to influence how a new operation grows and develops? If so, we'd love to hear from you.
Here at GXO Northampton, we are currently recruiting for full-time, permanent Warehouse Operatives to join our team in Swan Valley, supporting our new business win Savers! From receiving and storing products to picking, packing, and dispatching orders you will be involved in all aspects of our warehouse operations.
You will be working on a full-time , permanent basis, on a two-week rota pattern: Week 1 – Monday to Friday / Week 2 – Sunday to Thursday, covering the hours of 22:00 to 06:00 , contracted to 40 hours per week.
Pay, benefits and more:
As a Warehouse Operative, there’s lots that we can offer you:
An hourly rate of £15.39 inclusive of night shift allowance
33 days annual leave (inclusive of Bank Holidays)
Flexible dental insurance plans
Company sponsored pension scheme
24/7 online GP service, life assurance and fully comprehensive employee assistance programme

Support goods-in, goods-out and stock control activities using the Warehouse Management System (WMS), including receiving deliveries, replenishment, order fulfilment and dispatch operations

items.title: Customer Service Advisor
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Reports to: Branch Manager / Area Operations Manager Location: Bedford Department: Customer Service / Operations
Our Client is looking for an experienced customer Service Advisor to join their growing team. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, enjoy building strong customer relationships, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.
As part of our ambitious growth strategy, our goal is to triple the number of repeat customers over the next five years . This role is central to achieving that ambition by ensuring every customer receives outstanding service, expert support, and a seamless experience from enquiry through to order fulfilment.
As a Customer Service Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, providing a friendly, professional, and efficient service across a broad range of products. You'll process customer orders, manage enquiries, resolve issues, and work closely with colleagues across the business to deliver an outstanding customer experience.
This is a varied role that combines customer service, sales support, administration, and operational collaboration, making it ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership and making a real difference.
Deliver outstanding customer service across phone, email, and other communication channels.
Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring prompt fulfilment.
Handle customer enquiries and provide product guidance and recommendations.
Escalate technical product enquiries to specialist teams where appropriate.
Resolve customer issues and complaints professionally, achieving positive outcomes.
Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure smooth order processing.
Follow up quotations and proactively engage with customers.
Identify and communicate sales opportunities to the External Sales Team.
Support branch operations, including warehouse or trade counter activities when required.
Participate in stock cycle counting.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
Support the wider branch team and undertake additional duties as required.
We're looking for someone who enjoys helping customers, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and works well as part of a team.
You'll ideally have:
Previous experience in a customer service, sales support, or internal sales role.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail.
The ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
A proactive approach to problem solving and customer service.
Experience using ERP or order processing systems (desirable).
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
A willingness to develop product knowledge and learn about our industry.
In this role, you'll help ensure:
Customers receive consistently outstanding service.
Orders are processed accurately and efficiently.
Customer enquiries and complaints are resolved quickly and professionally.
Strong customer relationships are developed and maintained.
Sales opportunities are identified and passed to the relevant teams.
The branch achieves improvements in customer retention, sales growth, and operational performance.
You make a positive contribution to our team culture and business success.
You'll become part of a supportive team where your contribution is recognised, your ideas are valued, and you'll have opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career. Every day brings new challenges, and you'll play an important role in helping us achieve our ambitious growth plans while delivering an exceptional experience for our customers.
Ready to join us?
Apply today and become part of a business that's committed to putting customers first and building lasting relationships.
Please note that at times due to the volume of applications we may not be able to respond to each person individually. If you do not hear from us within 7 days we’re sorry you have not been successful this time. Please do not let this stop you applying for other positions you may be suitable for. Good Luck! 1st Choice Staff Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer and acts as both an Employment Agency & Business.

This position will be based in our clients Luton office and is a fully-office based role. Our client is paying a salary upto £27k for a candidate with strong experience.

Preparing and processing shipping and administrative documentation
Coordinating collections and deliveries with clients, couriers and internal teams
Responding to client enquiries by telephone and email

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
An opportunity has arisen for a part time sales assistant at Glenray Jewellers, a long established, independent jeweller and third generation family business.
We are a small, owner led business with a friendly and professional approach. This role would suit someone who would enjoy working closely with an experienced owner in a small team environment where trust, reliability and customer care and sales ability are all important.
if you are a retail professional with a genuine passion for selling, this might be an opportunity you would like to consider.
You will support customers, build trust and help convert enquiries into sales in a professional, honest and considered way.
HOURS
The shop is open Monday to Saturday. The time is expected to be 3 to 3.5 days a week, including regular Saturdays.
Full days: 8.50am-5.50pm with a 45 minute lunch break.
Wednesday half day : 8.50am -1.30pm
Saturdays are essential.
Exact working days will usually follow a regular pattern and will be agreed with some flexibility required to provide cover when needed.
The role includes:
Actively selling jewellery and supporting customers through their purchase decisions.
Working closely with the owner and small team to provide a high standard of customer service.
Confidently discussing products, pricing and options with customers.
Contributing to successful sales outcomes through good listening, product presentation and follow up.
Building rapport and encouraging repeat visits.
Handling repair, valuation and special order enquiries.
Processing sales accurately and professionally.
Supporting the smooth day to day running of the shop.
Opening and closing duties including putting window and counter displays out each morning and removing and securing them at the end of the day.
Cleaning and preparing jewellery for display or customer viewing where necessary, using appropriate methods and equipment.
General housekeeping tasks, including keeping displays, counters and the shop floor, clean, tidy and presentable.
Full product and systems training will be provided. A strong sales mindset is essential, along with the ability to work collaboratively in a small, owner led business.
Essential skills and experience:
Proven face to face retail sales experience.
Comfortable speaking with customers about products and pricing.
Able to support and progress sales conversations professionally.
Confident, articulate and customer focused.
Reliable, punctual and well presented.
Jewellery experience is desirable but not essential.
The time will suit someone who:
Enjoys selling in a customer facing retail environment
Is comfortable working closely with an experienced owner
Values professionalism, trust, reliability and customer care
Enjoys being part of a small independent business
Is looking for a long term part time role
Pay
£13.50 to £14.50 per hour, depending on experience.
Please note this is a sales focused role and regular Saturday availability is essential. Applications from candidates who cannot work Saturdays are unlikely to be successful.

items.title: People Administrator
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Are you passionate about people and delivering outstanding support? We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced People Administrator to join our People (HR) team at the heart of our people function. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the employee experience, supporting colleagues at every stage of their journey while ensuring all HR processes are delivered with accuracy, efficiency, and a personal touch.
Key Responsibilities
Onboarding : Coordinate and manage the onboarding process for new starters, ensuring a smooth and welcoming experience.
Lifecycle Administration : Process employee changes, manage leaver procedures, and maintain accurate records throughout the employee journey.
Query Resolution : Act as a key point of contact for general people and benefits-related queries, providing timely, people focused, and clear responses.
People Experience : Deliver a high quality, personal service that reflects a people first approach, ensuring every interaction is professional and personable.
Administrative Support : Carry out general people administration tasks, maintaining data integrity and confidentiality at all times.
Collaboration : Work closely with other PX Hub team members and stakeholders to ensure consistency and excellence in service delivery.
Essential Criteria
Experience in HR or people administration.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships.
High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
A proactive, organised, and solution-focused approach to work.
Desirable Criteria
Experience working in a fast-paced environment.
Experience using HR systems and databases.
Knowledge of HR processes and employment-related administration.
Experience supporting multiple stakeholders across different teams or locations.
Personal Attributes
Warm, approachable, and professional.
Passionate about delivering a positive people experience.
Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive information.
Adaptable and committed to continuous improvement.
Additional Information
Willmott Dixon embraces diversity in the workplace and will consider flexible and agile working.
We are a disability confident employer. Benefits: In return we reward our people generously with a competitive package that gives you flexible benefits to fit your lifestyle and priorities. This includes but is not limited to, an enhanced pension scheme, fully discounted private medical, life assurance, incentive bonus and a car scheme which will make us a market leader in sustainable company travel. Applicable roles will benefit from a motoring expenditure allowance (MEA) and everyone can access a new generation of low carbon and electric cars via the Willmott Dixon run car leasing scheme.
About Us
With 170 years of rich history, Willmott Dixon's purpose beyond profit is to deliver brilliant buildings, transform lives, strengthen communities, and enhance the environment so our world is fit for future generations. Ensuring that we add lasting value to the neighbourhoods we work in; our values, people, innovation, partnerships and focus on sustainability has allowed us to build a successful and trusted privately owned business where our people can thrive.
Willmott Dixon was recognised by The Sunday Times as one of the Top 10 "Big" Companies to Work For in 2025, named among the Times Top 50 Employers for Gender Equality in 2024, and ranked in the Top Five of Europe's 1,000 best workplaces by the Financial Times in 2025. Willmott Dixon is also the first major contractor and developer to win a King's Award for Enterprise in the category of sustainable development.

items.text:
Job Description
£30,638 per annum / £14.73 per hour Wednesday to Sunday 4pm to 1am 40 hours per week
As a Production Operative in our Bicester depot, you’ll play an important part ensuring our freshly prepared products are delivered on time to meet our customer demands.
Your role is to ensure that products manufactured at Fresh Kitchen are handled and managed to the agreed production schedule and that they comply with specific customer requirement with key focus on product quality, legality and safety and overall presentation of product to the customer. In addition, key areas of responsibility include receiving goods in, maintaining good stock rotation/management and working towards targets and deadlines.
To join us as a Production Operative, you’ll be comfortable working in a temperature controlled (chilled) environment – don’t worry we’ll give uniform to keep you warm! You will be handling and preparing various food products including meat and fish and spend most of the day on your feet. Experience in a food production environment or knowledge of basic food safety would be an advantage, but your ability to learn and be part of the team is more important.
In addition to a competitive monthly salary, 31 days annual leave (inc. statutory) and company pension, you can also look forward to the following benefits:
Wagestream – Access to an app that gives you early access to your earned salary and supports financial wellbeing
The option to purchase additional annual leave
Help at Hand - Access to 24/7 GP appointments, physiotherapy and a range of health and wellbeing services for you and your family
Life assurance
Access to Sysco Perks offering discounts across a wide range of products and services – from gym membership to your weekly supermarket shop
The ability to purchase our products at hugely discounted prices
To enjoy the rewards of joining our supportive team, apply now.

items.text:
Join Our Growing Team at Warburtons!
Function: Distribution
Contract: 4 on 2 off rota. 6pm - 3am
Salary: £675.18
Join the team behind the UK’s No.1 bakery brand and help keep households stocked with the products millions know and love. The Biggleswade site is a modern, state-of-the-art operation featuring the latest iCart technology and a fast-growing So, if you’re a Warehouse Team Member or Operative, looking for a role with a bit more substance (and crust!), this could be your moment to prove you’re made of the right stuff.
Previous experience as a Warehouse Operative ideally gained in a food environment
Detailed knowledge and experience of working towards all SOPs which effect a warehouse
Effective manual handling techniques training undertaken
Knowledge of SAP to enable allocation of product and closing of orders
Understanding of requirements of Hygiene & Food Safety Legislation
Good communication skills- a team player, listens to others, respects differences in personal style and beliefs
Can prioritise and manage own workload to ensure tasks are delivered as promised
Decision making skills – makes effective decisions in areas affecting own job
Numeracy – mental arithmetic skills
Basic IT skills
As a Warehouse Team Member, you’ll be at the heart of our operations, ensuring smooth, efficient processes while upholding our reputation for exceptional service. Your key responsibilities will include:
To assemble and complete all orders on time and in full for primary and secondary distribution routes (where applicable). Identify deficits and take appropriate action to ensure the deficit is evenly distributed across all customers.
To ensure products despatched, comply with quality and date code requirements and comply with food safety legislation, initiating any required action.
To maintain Company hygiene and statutory hygiene standards throughout designated areas, working within the principles of basic food hygiene and good housekeeping.
To complete all paperwork on a timely and regular basis to ensure accurate recording and reporting of information.
To communicate progress on tasks with team members, highlighting operational issues to Team Manager or Managers (where applicable)
To stack and store all equipment in the appropriate areas, ensuring operational areas are safe and kept clear of equipment.
At Warburtons, we believe in investing in our people. You will be supported with a full induction and ongoing training from our in-house teams. Your knowledge of basic warehouse operations and transport legislation will be key for a smooth and safe day.
As the UK’s No. 1 Bakery Brand, we have been baking bread since 1876. Today, we are proudly a sixth-generation family business, supplying over 18,000 retail customers from 23 distribution sites, producing a range of over 70 products, including gluten and wheat-free options. We are striving to be a net-zero business by 2050 and believe in minimizing our impact on the environment while making a positive impact on society.
Biggleswade is known for being the home of the world's first-ever seed company, founded by Samuel Wells in the 18th century. Warburtons' newest site is conveniently situated with access to the A1, providing a gateway to the North and South, as well as easy access to both the East and West parts of England. Alongside its agricultural heritage, Biggleswade is ideally situated along the River Ivel and has a long-standing tradition of weekly markets dating back to the Middle Ages.
At last and by no means least you will want to know what your breads worth:
A slice of the annual profits (discretionary profit share)
Award winning pension scheme with company contributions up to 7%
Life assurance
Products you will love along with deals and discounts for you and the family through our Extra Dough website
Continued investment in your personal development
Fully stocked kitchens filled with our delicious products for you to enjoy with your daily brew!

And unlike many retail roles, you won’t work late evenings — plus you’ll enjoy three days off at Christmas.
Oh, and did we mention? You’ll earn commission on every sale you help makehappen.
What you’ll be doing
Building long-standing relationships with regular trade and retail customers through a consultative sales approach.
Asking the right questions to understand customer needs so you can confidently recommend the best products.
Using your creativity to inspire customers with colour, style, layout and design ideas.
Driving sales through expert product knowledge
Confidently closing sales and maximising every opportunity
No experience? No problem.
You don’t need to know anything about tiles — or even retail. If you’re outgoing, friendly, energetic and don’t mind lifting heavy boxes, we’ll give you all the training you need, including developing your sales confidence and skills through our simple, customer-first sales framework.
What’s in it for you?
Competitive basic salary
Sales commission
No evening work
Christmas Eve and Boxing Day off
Ongoing training, development and progression opportunities
Generous Staff Discount
Access to our Benefits platform with a wide range of discounts from 100s of retailers.
You’ll love working for Topps — and we can’t wait to hear from you.
Click Apply today. The application should only take a few minutes if your CV is ready, and we’ll be in touch ASAP to arrange your chat with the hiring manager.
Due to health and safety requirements and the nature of our in-store work, we would encourage applications from individuals aged 18 or over.
Think you know Topps Group? Think again.
There's plenty about Topps Group that might surprise you. Like the fact that you don't need to be a DIY or tile expert to work in one of our stores or our Leicester based Support Centre.
Or the fact that that we're Britain's largest specialist tile retailer, with more than 1,600 in-store specialists providing world class customer service to homeowners and tradespeople in over 300 stores nationwide.

items.text:
Electrical Engineer (Energy Efficiency)
Home-based (Field Engineer) Covering the South of England - Milton Keynes, Northampton, Luton, Cambridge, Oxford and surrounding areas
£50,000 (OTE £58,000 - £65,000) + Company Van + Fuel Card + Door-to-Door Pay + Overtime + Profit Share + 25 Days Holiday + Benefits
Are you a qualified Electrical Engineer with commercial/industrial installation or maintenance experience?
Are you looking for a field-based position where you can work autonomously, receive specialist technical training and have the opportunity to progress into a regional leadership position?
This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and growing specialist engineering business operating within the energy efficiency and power quality sector. Due to continued growth and an increasing workload across the South of England, they are looking for an Electrical Engineer to join their expanding team.
In this role you will be responsible for a mixture of electrical maintenance, site surveys, installations and power quality studies across a wide range of customer sites. You will initially receive comprehensive training on the company's specialist technologies before working independently, with larger installations completed alongside other engineers.
The role will involve regular travel and occasional overnight stays, but offers excellent earning potential through door-to-door pay and overtime, alongside genuine long-term progression opportunities as the Southern operation continues to grow.
The role: *Field-based position covering the South of England. *£47,700 basic salary with typical earnings of £58,000-£65,000. *Door-to-door pay. *Overtime paid at 1.5x. *Sundays and bank holidays paid at 2x. *Full training on specialist energy-efficiency and power-quality technologies. *Electrical maintenance, site surveys and installations. *Power quality studies and fault finding. *Work across manufacturing, commercial, healthcare, food, aerospace and other industrial environments. *Initially work alongside experienced engineers before moving into a more autonomous position.
The person: *Qualified Electrical Engineer with NVQ Level 3 or equivalent. *Gold Card electrical qualification. *Commercial or industrial electrical background. *Experience with installation and/or maintenance. *Comfortable working independently and travelling regularly.. *Experience with larger electrical installations / high-current cabling is advantageous.
Reference Number: BBBH27859
To apply for this role or to be considered for further roles, please click "Apply Now" or contact Nathan Williams at Rise Technical Recruitment.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Multiskilled Maintenance Engineer
£50,000
3on3off
Yolk Recruitment is proud to represent a leading organisation in Milton Keynes, in their search for a Multiskilled Maintenance Engineer.
Operating as part of a wider group, the company is a key player in the area. With a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence, the company continues to invest in its people, processes, and technology to maintain its position as an industry leader.
After significant investment in 2025 they are keen to employ several multiskilled Engineer to join their team.
Position Overview:
As a Maintenance Engineer working a 3on3off shift you will be a crucial part of our client's operations. You will be responsible for maintaining and repairing a range of equipment, ensuring the smooth running of production processes, and contributing to the overall efficiency of the facility. If you're a skilled engineer looking for a challenging and rewarding role, this is your opportunity.
This is what you'll be doing.
Conducting both planned and reactive maintenance to minimise downtime and ensure the smooth running of production lines
Diagnosing and repairing mechanical and electrical faults in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Ensuring all work complies with health and safety standards and food industry regulations
Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, optimising processes and enhancing efficiency
Working collaboratively with production and engineering teams to ensure seamless operation
The experience you'll bring to the team.
Previous experience in a maintenance engineering role within a fast paced manufacturing or food production environment
Strong electrical fault-finding and repair skills
A proactive and problem-solving approach, with the ability to work effectively under pressure
Recognised Electrical Engineering Qualifications (NVQ, HNC, or equivalent)
Ability to work independently and as part of a team within a fast-paced setting
And this is what you'll get in return.
A salary of circa £50,000
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge equipment.
Are you up to the challenge?
Are you what we're looking for? Please get in touch today with engineering specialist recruiter, Andy Jones
Please apply with a CV and feel free to include a cover letter outlining why you're perfect for the role. We also have a referral scheme so if you know of someone who would be great for the role please get in touch.
*Please note, whilst we do our best to contact all candidates, due to the high number of applications we receive we cannot guarantee this for every role. If you have not heard anything from us within 7 days of applying - then unfortunately you have been unsuccessful. Please keep an eye on our website for more opportunities.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
We are recruiting a National Installation Engineer for our client who are a leading diagnostic solutions and medical equipment provider. This role is field based, but you will need to be within a 45 min commute of Milton Keynes and travel will be across the UK and Ireland and international travel for training for the first few weeks.
The National Installation Engineer is responsible for the assembly, configuration, quality assurance, and installation of automated equipment, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Working closely with customers and internal teams, the role supports the end-to-end installation process, from pre-build activities through to commissioning at customer sites.
Key Responsibilities:
Carry out pre-installation activities within agreed timelines, including building modules and conveyor systems, completing sensitivity calibrations, and configuring IT systems.
Prepare equipment for dispatch to customer sites.
Complete equipment installations at customer locations within specified timescales.
Maintain effective communication with customers, providing updates throughout all stages of the installation process.
Complete end-to-end quality assurance checks and processes.
Accurately complete all required administrative tasks via the service portal.
Support Field Service teams when required with planned maintenance inspections, corrective actions, and other technical campaigns.
Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with company quality, health and safety, and customer service standards.
Essential Requirements:
This national role involves travel throughout UK and Ireland, with pre-builds taking place at the Milton Keynes head office.
Able to travel across Europe and the Middle East to complete company training.
Level 3 qualification in electrical engineering or equivalent.
Experience of pre-builds or installations and able to carry out fault finding when required.
Able to demonstrate a good standard of mechanical/technical knowledge.
Understanding of hydraulic and pneumatic principles.
Experience of reading and understanding technical diagrams.
HND (HNC with relevant experience) or equivalent in electronic and mechanical engineering (desirable)
Technical training on Haematology related instrumentation. (desirable)

items.text:
Are you ready for that next step in your career? Do you thrive in a fast paced environment where teamwork rules? Have you just recently completed an apprenticeship and want to put your learning into real life practice?
Here at GXO, we are currently recruiting for a Facilities Service Engineer to join our team in Milton Keynes, supporting our two sites for our customer Waitrose. As a Facilities Service Engineer you will carry out planned mechanical preventative maintenance on cage repairs and racking repairs including reactive repairs, PPM’s and racking inspections while utilising the computerised maintenance management system (CMMS) to support the smooth running of the operation.
This is a full time, permanent position, working Monday to Friday on a rotating shift pattern of 05:30 till 13:30 and 13:30 till 21:30.
Pay, benefits and more:
We’re looking to offer a salary of up to £32,000.00 per annum, and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays). Your benefits package includes, a company sponsored pension scheme, private medical & dental insurance, a 24/7 online GP service, life assurance and a fully comprehensive employee assistance programme. You’ll also have access to our MyBenefits platform offering a variety of high street discounts, a cycle to work scheme, cashback cards, a saving scheme and much more!
What you’ll do on a typical day:
Effective upkeep and performance of mechanical and equipment up to employee trained competency level
Identify and progress continuous improvement opportunities within the department and across all areas of the operation, enhancing the service to our customer
Monitor plant and mechanical equipment as necessary including use of the BMS system
Required from time to time to cover mechanical maintenance tasks at other Waitrose campus sites as part of the Waitrose Engineering Team
What you need to succeed at GXO:
Holder of 18 edition wiring is desirable however, not essential. We will support you to gain this in your first six months
Response to and reporting of incidents to ensure communication is maintained across shifts
Facilities/engineering mechanical background with an apprenticeship being advantageous
We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.
GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. GXO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate, support and thrive on diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe that diversity and inclusion in our business is critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. We are an Armed Forces friendly organisation and Disability Confident Leader as part of the Disability Confident Scheme (GIS) and actively welcome applications from people with disabilities.

items.text:
Assistant Window Fitter Are you the ideal Assistant Window Fitter or handy labourer looking for a trainee opportunity with fast-track career progression in a nationwide company fitting windows & doors with the best in the industry? Our client is currently looking for Assistant Window Fitters to join in the success of this nationwide window & door repair and replacement business. Their window fitters and joiners have been happily servicing Blue Chip insurance companies since 1986. Due to expansion our client is keen to recruit assistant window fitters, working from their flagship branch in Luton. The ideal UPVC Window Fitter daily responsibilities include: * Removing old windows and doors using hand and power tools. * Fit new windows and doors. * To take measurements for new fittings and make any bespoke changes. * To fix windows, doors, and other products. * To clear away any materials left after the job is finished. * To repair and replace products as the customer requests. * Take part in ongoing training and development. Skills and Experience as an UPVC Assistant Window Fitter
The ideal candidate is likely to have some experience of fitting windows, doors and fitting conservatories in UPVC or general building work and keen to progress.
The ideal fitter will be trustworthy and able to work on their own initiative when assisting with windows and doors on site.
Be Health & Safety conscious.
A Driving license is essential.
UPVC Assistant Window Fitter - Benefits
Good rates of pay depending upon experience + Overtime.
28 days full holiday entitlement per year.
Pension Scheme.
Company Work wear.
Industry leading training and development.
Salary A competitive salary whilst training up to £31,200 (£600 per week) and rapid career progression with salary reviews up to £36,000 (£700 per week) once fully trained as a competent window fitter. This is a FULL-TIME PAYE career with fast-track progression, NOT a temporary contract. Our client has secured long term contracts with major Insurance companies, this ensures they can GUARANTEE work throughout the year, providing job security and reliability.

items.title: Prototyping and Maintenance Engineer
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Manpower are currently seeking an interim Prototyping and Maintenance Engineer, to work with our global FMCG client, renowned for brands such as Magnum, Ben & Jerry's, Cornetto and Wall's, and become an integral part of their fast-paced FMCG environment.
The position is based at our client's Research & Development facility, at Colworth Science Park, in Sharnbrook, Bedfordshire (MK44), accessible by car or shuttle bus from Bedford train station.
It also houses our client's global centre of excellence in safety and sustainability sciences.
This is a full-time temporary role to run for 6 months with possibility of extension, requiring 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Compensation for this role is competitive, paying up to £50,000 per annum, pro rata, depending upon experience.
The ice cream processing team at is looking for a temporary Prototyping and Maintenance Engineer to join the global innovation centre of the world's largest ice cream company. This exciting role sits within an established team of multi-skilled engineers and focuses on delivering prototype equipment and machinery for new ice cream product manufacturing through skilled machining and fabrication. The role also supports the day-to-day maintenance of a busy pilot plant producing prototype ice creams. It offers an excellent opportunity for a recently qualified apprentice to build new skills and knowledge, or for an experienced engineer seeking a new challenge in the innovative world of ice cream.
The Prototyping and Maintenance Engineer will lead the fabrication and assembly of mechanical parts and components to support the implementation of new process technologies. This will involve close collaboration with designers, process development engineers, project teams and key external partners, including machinery, component, process technology and control system suppliers. The role also supports planned and reactive maintenance, as well as troubleshooting activities, within a highly utilised Pilot Plant. The role will encompass approximately 70% prototyping and 30% maintenance,
Main Accountabilities
Manufacture prototype mechanical components, sub-systems, nozzles and jigs using modern engineering machinery, manual and CNC machine tools, and TIG/spot welding equipment, working with stainless steel, food-grade aluminum and plastics.
Use precision measuring instruments to verify parts are manufactured accurately against drawings and specifications.
Collaborate with designers, control engineers and process engineers to create practical engineering solutions.
Work independently to deliver one-off prototypes, assemblies and machined parts to food-grade standards.

items.title: Trainee Site Operative
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Trainee Site Operative
Are you practical, motivated and looking to build a specialist career in a hands-on outdoor role? This is an excellent opportunity to join our team at Chiltern Thrust Bore and receive full training in trenchless technology, including horizontal directional drilling and guided auger boring, while working on projects across the UK and developing towards becoming a skilled Driller and Auger Bore Operator. Previous construction or civil engineering experience is not essential, making this an accessible opportunity for someone with technical aptitude, a positive attitude and a genuine willingness to learn.
FULL TRAINING PROVIDED
All levels of experience considered. Candidates do not necessarily need previous construction or civil engineering experience as full training will be provided. However, will require a technical aptitude and a willingness to learn new skills.
If you’ve also worked in the following roles, we’d also like to hear from you: Construction Operative, Trainee Construction Operative, Site Assistant, Construction Labourer, Site Labourer, Civils Operative, Drilling Operative, Assistant Driller, Drilling Assistant, Groundworker
SALARY: Starting from £33,800 per annum (£130 per day) + Career Development Opportunities
LOCATION: Olney, Buckinghamshire
This role will involve extensive UK travel with overnight stays . Additional remuneration when working away from home.
JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent
WORKING HOURS: Monday to Friday, 10 hours per day (However, there may be occasions when there is a potential to work overtime and specific projects requiring Night and/or Weekend working at additional rates)
PLEASE NOTE: Candidates will need a Driving Licence and their own vehicle to commute to the offices in Olney, Buckinghamshire. Company Transport will be provided when travelling to project sites nationwide.
** Opportunities to Train as a Skilled Driller and Auger Bore Operative **
JOB OVERVIEW
The company has an excellent opportunity for a Trainee Site Operative who enjoys practical, physical work and wants to learn a specialist trade. The company provides trenchless technology services to the construction and civil engineering sectors nationwide, using techniques including horizontal directional drilling and guided auger boring.
Working as the Trainee Site Operative you will travel throughout the UK with an experienced team, assisting across trenchless technology projects and learning directly from established lead drillers. The role offers both in-house and off-site training, provided and paid for by the company, with the aim of developing successful candidates into fully qualified drilling and Auger Bore Operators.
Previous construction-sector or directional drilling experience is advantageous but is not essential. As the Trainee Site Operative you will instead need a strong work ethic, technical aptitude, physical fitness and a willingness to learn while maintaining high standards of health and safety.
The role involves extensive UK travel. Some projects will require overnight stays away from home during the working week. Accommodation will be provided by the company together with an additional allowance and expenses when working away.
DUTIES
Your duties as the Trainee Site Operative include:
Supporting Trenchless Projects: Assist experienced team members with the delivery of trenchless technology services, including horizontal directional drilling, guided auger boring and associated site activities
Learning Specialist Techniques: Complete company-funded in-house and off-site training while developing the practical and technical skills required to progress towards becoming a skilled Driller and Auger Bore Operator
Assisting Lead Drillers: Work closely with lead drillers and other experienced colleagues, following instructions and supporting the safe and effective completion of project activities
Working Safely on Site: Follow safe working practices and maintain a high level of health and safety awareness to protect colleagues, contractors, members of the public and yourself
Supporting Nationwide Projects: Travel with the team from the Olney office to project locations across the UK, including staying away from home when required
Developing Technical Skills: Build knowledge of specialist equipment, working methods and trenchless technology through practical experience and structured training
Contributing to the Site Team: Take a positive, hands-on approach to physical site work and contribute effectively as a reliable member of the project team
CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
ESSENTIAL
Full valid UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle to commute to the company’s offices in Olney, Buckinghamshire. Company transport is provided from the office to project sites nationwide
Willingness to travel extensively throughout the UK and stay away from home during the working week when projects require it
Flexibility to work nights or weekends when required
Positive, can-do attitude with a genuine willingness to learn new skills and develop a specialist trade
Technical aptitude and an interest in practical, hands-on work
Physical fitness suitable for an outdoor and physically active site-based role
Fluency in verbal and written English
Successful applicants must obtain a CSCS/CPCS card at their own expense if they do not already hold one
DESIRABLE
Previous experience within construction or a related environment
Experience or skills relating to directional drilling or guided auger boring
HGV Class 2 licence; however, this is advantageous only and this is not a driving role
NO AGENCIES PLEASE
HOW TO APPLY
To be considered for this job vacancy, please submit your CV to our Recruitment Team who will review your details.
JOB REF: AWDO-P15165
This job is being advertised by AWD online on behalf of Chiltern Thrust Bore
AWD-IN-SPJ
