items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Introduction
Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training.
What you will be part of
Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe.
Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems.
Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations.
The Role:
This is a 3 month contract role, part of our Blue Bear Business Unit in Bedfordshire.
The Technician will be primarily tasked with the build, modification, and repair of uncrewed systems back at base, ensuring hardware is prepped to rigorous standards. While not involved in the direct operation of the system, this role will provide critical support in the field when required. Success in this role will ensure all assemblies meet high-quality and safety standards while supporting rapid prototyping and ongoing maintenance cycles.
Key Responsibilities
Preventative Maintenance & Assembly: Execute the mechanical and electrical assembly of uncrewed systems.
Routine Care: Conduct thorough preventative maintenance on all systems to ensure optimal operational readiness and longevity.
Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Perform complex fault-finding and diagnostics on malfunctioning hardware back at base.
Repairs & Modifications: Implement necessary repairs, upgrades, and structural modifications to existing fleets based on engineering schematics.
Field Support: Deploy to field testing sites as required to provide hands-on technical support, rapid repair, and hardware troubleshooting (excluding direct system operation).
Skills and Experience:
Essential Skills
Proven background in mechanical or electrical assembly, ideally within an aerospace, robotics, or automotive environment.
Strong practical ability in diagnosing hardware faults and troubleshooting complex systems.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation.
Desirable Skills
Experience or familiarity with Civil and Military Aviation regulatory requirements (CAA, MAA, EASA) and industry standards.
Ability to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC level).
By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
Follow site Health & Safety standards, including PPE, LOTO, isolation, safe entry, permit, and contractor control procedures.
Support a safe working environment by ensuring safety checks, job sign-offs, and equipment records are completed correctly.
Ensure compliance with Quality Management Systems, GMP, HACCP, Food Safety, Environmental, and company standards.
Complete maintenance documentation accurately and ensure records are available for internal and external audits.
Carry out multi-skilled maintenance activities across electrical, mechanical, and controls disciplines.
Respond to breakdowns, troubleshoot faults, and ensure equipment is returned to a safe and serviceable condition.
Complete planned preventative maintenance activities and work orders within agreed timescales.
Record all maintenance work accurately in the CMMS, including spare parts usage.
Coordinate with stores personnel to ensure required spare parts are available.
Provide clear written handovers to the oncoming shift and communicate key issues effectively.
Work closely with Engineering, Production, Operations, Quality, and Project teams to improve equipment reliability, product quality, and operational performance.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Organised, proactive, and able to work independently or as part of a team.
COMPANY
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales., the Company manufactures, markets and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

items.text:
Insight Employment is currently recruiting for our client based in Bedford
This is an exciting opportunity to work within a fast-paced manufacturing environment, where a variety of roles are available such as Canning line Operator, Counterbalance Driver and more.
We have have a number of Counterbalance Forklift permanent vacances with an immediate start. You must be able to work all 3 shift patterns, which changes weekly. Basic salary is £27,363.63 per annum + monthly shift allowance bonus of £6,684.39 per annum.
Roles & duties: –
Canning line Operator
Key responsibilities: –
Monitor conveyor belts and canning line equipment to ensure products meet quality standards.
Inspect cans and bottles for defects, reporting any issues promptly.
Maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail throughout the production process.
Operate production machinery safely and efficiently.
Carry out routine checks and basic maintenance as required.
Follow all company procedures relating to food safety, quality control, and health & safety.
Support the wider production team to achieve daily production targets.
Counterbalance Forklift Driver with double fork
Key Responsibilities: –
Operate forklifts and clamp trucks safely and efficiently, completing all required health & safety checks.
Load and unload incoming and outgoing vehicles.
Move empty containers and finished products throughout the site.
Transport materials between warehouse, canning, and production areas.
Carry out FLT gas bottle changes and gas loading when required.
Use SAP handheld devices and systems to accurately book stock in and out.
Maintain high standards of housekeeping, cleanliness, and hygiene within the work area.
Support operational activities including material handling, cleaning, and basic autonomous maintenance tasks.
Ensure equipment, tools, and materials are used correctly and report any faults, defects, or incidents promptly.
Adhere to all Quality, Food Safety, HACCP, Food Defence, and Health & Safety requirements.
Support the achievement of site productivity and performance targets.
Key Requirements: –
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
A valid, accredited Counterbalance Forklift Licence (in-date preferred; refresher training can be provided on-site).
At least 2 years’ forklift driving experience.
Proven experience operating double counterbalance forklifts (handling two pallets simultaneously).
Previous warehouse experience/canning line or with a fast-paced food production/manufacturing environment
A willingness to undertake general warehouse duties alongside forklift operations
Good physical fitness, as some manual handling and lifting may be required
The ability to stand for extended periods and undertake manual handling
A sound understanding of health & safety procedures and safe working practices.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Excellent timekeeping and attendance record.
A reliable, hardworking, and positive attitude.
Support the achievement of site productivity and performance targets.
Working Hours: –
Hours can vary depending on the role, but are likely to be as follows: –
06:00am – 14:00pm
14:00pm – 22:00pm
22:00pm – 06:00am
Please note: Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Up to £34,048.02 per annum depending on the position & your experience

Company pension scheme
Cycle to Work scheme
On-site gym
On-site parking
Employee discount programme
Employee mentoring programme
Health and wellbeing programme
Company events
Discounted or free food
Sick pay

You will be contracted to a set minimum number of hours per week, and you will be required to be flexible to work additional hours to deliver the best customer experience, especially during the peak trading winter heating season. Where possible, hours and shifts will be agreed with you with plenty of notice so that you know exactly what you are doing and when! You’ll naturally promote and embrace our inclusive team environment and we’re sure you’ll have some fun along the way! You'll be flexible with working hours, and your approach to delivering customer and business needs. Working closely with internal teams, candidates, and international stakeholders, you will play a key role in supporting examination administration, certification processes, database management, and customer service activities. items.title: Driver and Branch Sales Assistant
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text: #BelongWithUs Come and join us as a Branch Sales Assistant and Driver on a flexible 20-37.5 hours basis to help us grow, deliver sales and exceed customer expectations. The role: As a Driver and Branch Sales Assistant, you’ll be committed to delivering an outstanding level of service, and you’ll be professional, driven and enthusiastic. The Driver and Branch Sales Assistant role reports into the branch management team and will provide the highest level of service to internal and external customers, and will deliver products to our customers against some very tight deadlines. This role will also be customer facing within the branch, serving on the trade counter and dealing with customers over the telephone ensuring that we provide the best service and maximise sales at every opportunity. You will be contracted to a set minimum number of hours per week, and you will be required to be flexible to work additional hours to deliver the best customer experience, especially during the peak trading winter heating season. Where possible, hours and shifts will be agreed with you with plenty of notice so that you know exactly what you are doing and when! You’ll naturally promote and embrace our inclusive team environment and we’re sure you’ll have some fun along the way! Please note, this role requires you to have the appropriate driving licence with previous experience as a driver Key Responsibilities: Health and safety of yourself and your vehicle Maintenance and condition of your vehicle Report any issues or incidents to your line manager Comply with transport compliance law and regulations Supporting the Branch Manager and Assistant Branch Manager with achieving and exceeding sales targets at optimum margins. Ensuring we maintain high standards, creating and maintaining a loyal customer base and providing a first class service. Assisting with the general duties within the branch such as serving customers on the trade counter, telesales and ensuring the housekeeping standards are maintained both on the trade counter and warehousing You: Along with a clean driving licence, you will ideally have previous driving experience and knowledge of the products associated with our industry would be an advantage. You'll be flexible with working hours, and your approach to delivering customer and business needs. You’ll thrive on providing the best customer service and being a huge support to your branch colleagues Us: From boilers to bathroom suites, tubing to towel rails and everything in between, City Plumbing has all the products our customers need to complete the job. And we have all you need to build a successful career! We’re proud of our reputation for selling quality plumbing and heating products to both trade and retail customers and we’re super excited about our future. We put our colleagues at the heart of all we do, giving them all the tools they need to be successful, happy and feel rewarded in their career with us. Benefits Package and Cultural Environment: Bonus Discounts, savings and cash back at numerous retailers Life assurance Extended family policy including maternity, paternity, additional annual leave and more Mental Health First Aiders and Employee Assistance Programme, we look out for each other Complete induction and a company that lets you grow and encourages development Financial education and loans Flexible working options A business striving to create an environment of inclusion so everyone can be their true self And more! #BelongWithUs We’re passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates and values diversity. Bring your whole self to work regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We don’t want you to ‘fit’ our culture, we want you to enrich it. We are committed to best practices in recruitment and undertake Basic Criminal Record Disclosures for candidates that are offered employment within our branches that undertake deliveries for British Gas. This check will only be undertaken after the acceptance of an offer of employment
